Method of Attack: Unauthenticated command injection allowing execution of commands on the device's underlying firmware from its web management interface
Impacted Systems: Seagate Personal Cloud Home Media Storage NAS
Attack Vector: Malformed requests to vulnerable Media Server web application endpoints (getLogs and uploadTelemetry) accessible only from the local network (LAN)
Phishing or malvertising to trick users into accessing malformed URLs on the same network
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code enabling remote SSH access and root password change
Seagate Personal Cloud changelog version 4.3.18.0 indicating patch
